name: Jernail Singh Anand

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jernail Singh Anand is a poet and prose writer from Punjab, and founder-president of the International Academy of Ethics. His writing includes the Mahakaal Trilogy and works of literary criticism. In an interview published by the academy, he describes literature as a way to bring ethical questions into ordinary life, and argues that books should reach people beyond academic discussion.

His Kabita Live poems approach those questions through familiar images. “MEMORIES” imagines the past as water we continue to inhabit, while a mind carries its stations even after a train has left them behind. “TRUTH: PARTIAL AND IMPARTIAL” sets poetry’s power to soothe and interpret against the violence and contested narratives of history. Together, they ask how language shapes what we remember and what we accept as true.
